questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** Abscond**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abscond"** means to go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere. (गायब होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The thief managed to abscond with the stolen jewels before the police arrived.
 
 
 
• **"Abscond"** refers to the act of fleeing or escaping, typically to avoid arrest or capture. (गायब होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The employee absconded with the company's funds and was never seen again.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vanish** (गायब होना): To disappear suddenly and completely.

 
 
• **Example:** The magician made the rabbit vanish into thin air.
 
 
 
• **Excavate** (खोदना): To dig out material from the ground.
 
 
• **Example:** The archaeologists began to excavate the ancient ruins.
 
 
 
• **Extradite** (प्रत्यर्पित करना): To hand over a person accused or convicted of a crime to the jurisdiction of the foreign state in which the crime was committed.
 
 
• **Example:** The government agreed to extradite the fugitive to his home country.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The allowance that is given by a husband to his wife on separation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Alimony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Allowance"** refers to an amount of money that is given regularly to meet specific needs or expenses. (भत्ता)

 
 
• **Example: **He receives a monthly allowance from his parents to cover his living expenses.
 
 
 
• **"Alimony"** refers to the financial support that one spouse is ordered to give to the other upon separation or divorce. (गुजारा भत्ता)
 
 
• **Example: **After their divorce, he was required to pay alimony to support his ex-wife.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **'Alimony'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Alimony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Matrimonial** (वैवाहिक): Relating to marriage or married people.

 
 
• **Example:** They sought matrimonial advice from a counselor.
 
 
 
• **Affluence** (समृद्धि): The state of having a great deal of money; wealth.
 
 
• **Example: **His affluence allowed him to donate generously to charity.
 
 
 
• **Dowry** (दहेज): Property or money brought by a bride to her husband on their marriage.
 
 
• **Example:** The practice of giving dowry is illegal in many countries.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A small shop that sells fashionable clothes
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Boutique**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Boutique'** means a small shop that sells fashionable clothes or accessories. (फैशनेबल कपड़े या सामान बेचने वाली छोटी दुकान)

 
 
• **Example: **She bought a beautiful dress from a boutique in Paris.
 
 
 
• **'Store'** refers to a place where goods are kept for sale, which can be large or small. (दुकान)
 
 
• **Example: **We went to the grocery **store** to buy some vegetables.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for a small shop that sells fashionable clothes is **'Boutique'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Boutique.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Store** (दुकान): A place where goods are kept for sale.

 
 
• **Example:** We went to the grocery** store** to buy some vegetables.
 
 
 
• **Tailoring** (सिलाई): The activity or trade of a tailor, making or altering clothing.
 
 
• **Example:** He learned **tailoring** from his father and now runs his own shop.
 
 
 
• **Couture** (उच्च फैशन): The design and manufacture of fashionable clothes to a client's specific requirements and measurements.
 
 
• **Example:** The **couture** dress she wore was designed by a famous fashion house.
